title: Lockscreen/Always On values on LG G5 phone.
body:
Lockscreen value does not update (static after started) - Note: Notification value does update normally.
Settings for both are not persistent...neither survive rebooting the phone, but can be re-enabled with settings (just see the drip logo in both lockscreen and notification). Settings show controls are 'On', but have to turn them off, do the 'test' and turn back on.
Xdrip version c4f10b9-2018-.06.14
Phone - LG G5

comments.body: I wonder if the always on behavior might change using notification channels for the ongoing notification (pr #444). On both my Nexus 5x and Pixel 2 xl, I get working always on notifications, with the only caveat being that if a reading was missed there is no indication that the value is not new (the old bg notification re-pops up after 5 minutes).
How I can put the xdrip glucose reading in the alway on display on a galaxy s7 edge (oreo)?
@chip83 Right now the closest is probably the Daydream (or screensaver) option in android's display settings, you'll see xdrip as an option

@zip9 Would you please close this issue if it has been addressed?
You can always use the support channels as well.
